# Video routing and render evidence

The original frozen V3 file-context case and render-only case each ran once. [Parent review](parent/review.json) accepts the V3 file-context behavior and the actual render artifact/scope. The render response nevertheless claimed frame-color inspection without observing the decoded image content. That reporting failure is retained separately from the successful independent decoder.

The approved root clarification explains that image/audio extraction and FFprobe metadata do not establish inspected content. A separate [corrected report trial](amendments/render-report-proof-launch.md) is frozen but has not run: automatic approval rejected its guidance payload, and a specific user decision is pending. Six isolated launcher/control/snapshot tests passed. Original runtime/task/private guidance and all1,114 original archive files remain unchanged. Prior prelaunch preparations and failures are preserved.

`runs/*/archive-layout.json` records duplicate-guidance omission and exact reconstruction; complete original before/after hashes remain. This fixture does not establish full video adoption, provider availability, final release acceptance or actual-machine rollout.
